name: ds-playground
title: Data structure playgrounds
description: Press operations on a vector, stack, queue, set, map, heap-backed priority queue, linked list or search tree and watch it change step by step, with a running cost counter, a log and each return value.

classPrefix.description: Prefix of the host class (<prefix>playground) and of generated classes (<prefix>op, <prefix>cost, <prefix>log, …), for page CSS and scripts.

maxSize.description: Most elements a playground holds unless its spec sets "max"; one more is refused with errorFull.

maxLength.description: Longest text value (in characters) unless a spec sets "maxLength".

logLimit.description: Most lines kept in the operation log (the oldest are dropped).

opLabels.description: Button text (and the name in the log) of every operation, keyed by operation name; a missing key shows the operation name.

keyLabel.description: Label of the key field (map, search tree).

priorityLabel.description: Label of the priority field (priority queue).

nextLabel.description: Step-by-step: show the next step of the operation in progress.

finishLabel.description: Step-by-step: jump to the end of the operation in progress (and of any queued preset operations).

stepLabel.description: Step-by-step status: {k} = current step, {n} = steps of this operation.

resetLabel.description: Back to the initial contents; clears the counter and the log.

zeroLabel.description: Sets the cost counter to zero and keeps the contents.

sizeLabel.description: Status line and frame heading: {size} = number of elements.

capacityLabel.description: Status line of a vector with a "capacity": {capacity} = slots in its array.

heightLabel.description: Status line of a search tree: {height} = its height.

emptyLabel.description: Shown in place of an empty structure.

topLabel.description: Name by the top element of a stack.

frontLabel.description: Name over the front element of a queue.

backLabel.description: Name over the back element of a queue.

frontBackLabel.description: Name over the only element of a one-element queue.

headLabel.description: Linked list: name of the pointer to the first node.

tailLabel.description: Linked list: name of the pointer to the last node (spec "tail": true).

curLabel.description: Linked list: name of the pointer that walks along the list during an operation.

valueField.description: Linked list: name of a node's value field.

nextField.description: Linked list: name of a node's next field.

entryFormat.description: Priority queue with "pairs": how an entry is written; {value}, {priority}.

returned.description: Result line of an operation that returns something; {value}.

noReturn.description: Result line of an operation that returns nothing; empty = none.

trueLabel.description: How a true result is written.

falseLabel.description: How a false result is written.

costMoved.description: Cost counter name: elements shifted or copied (vector).

costVisited.description: Cost counter name: nodes read (linked list, search tree).

costCompares.description: Cost counter name: comparisons (priority queue, set, map).

costTouched.description: Cost counter name: elements read or written (stack, queue).

costLast.description: Counter: words after the cost of the latest operation.

costTotal.description: Counter: words after the running total.

costShort.description: Cost in a log line; {label} = counter name, {n} = amount.

logEmpty.description: Shown in the log before the first operation.

errorIndex.description: Error: the index is not a position of the structure.

errorEmpty.description: Error: pop, peek, dequeue and similar on an empty structure.

errorFull.default: Full: this playground holds at most {max}
errorFull.description: Error: the structure already holds {max} elements.

errorKey.description: Error: map get or remove of a missing key.

errorInteger.description: Error: the index field does not hold a whole number.

errorNumber.description: Error: a number is needed (priority, or values of a numbers-only playground).

errorValue.description: Error: the value or key field is empty.

errorLong.description: Error: a text value is longer than maxLength; {n}.

errorOp.description: Error from the JavaScript API: the kind has no operation {op}.

noteGrow.default: Full: copy all {n} elements into a new array with room for {capacity}
noteGrow.description: Step note, vector: the array grows.

noteMove.description: Step note, vector: one element shifts.

noteWrite.description: Step note, vector: a value is written.

noteRemoved.description: Step note, vector and linked list: remove has finished; {size} = new size.

noteLeft.description: Step note, set, map and search tree: the search goes left of {other}.

noteRight.description: Step note: the search goes right of {other}.

noteNotFound.description: Step note: the search ended without finding {key}.

noteAlready.description: Step note, set and search tree: adding a key that is present changes nothing.

noteInsertAt.description: Step note, set, map and search tree: where a new key lands.

noteRemoveKey.description: Step note, set and map: a key is removed.

noteReplace.description: Step note, map: put on a present key.

noteAppend.description: Step note, priority queue: enqueue starts.

noteUpSwap.default: {value} comes before its parent {other}, so they swap
noteUpSwap.description: Step note, priority queue: bubbling up, a swap is due.

noteUpStop.default: {value} does not come before its parent {other}: done
noteUpStop.description: Step note, priority queue: bubbling up stops.

noteAtRoot.description: Step note, priority queue: bubbling up reached the root.

noteSwapped.description: Step note, priority queue: after a swap.

noteTakeRoot.default: The root {value} comes first: take it out
noteTakeRoot.description: Step note, priority queue: dequeue starts.

noteMoveLast.default: Move the last entry, {value}, to the root
noteMoveLast.description: Step note, priority queue: the last entry fills the hole.

noteDownSwap.default: Its child {other} comes before {value}, so they swap
noteDownSwap.description: Step note, priority queue: bubbling down, a swap is due.

noteDownStop.description: Step note, priority queue: bubbling down stops.

noteDownLeaf.description: Step note, priority queue: bubbling down reached a leaf.

noteVisit.description: Step note, linked list: the walking pointer reaches a node.

noteUseTail.default: Follow tail straight to the last node ({value})
noteUseTail.description: Step note, linked list with a tail pointer: add at the end.

noteNewNode.default: Link in a new node holding {value}
noteNewNode.description: Step note, linked list: a node is added.

noteUnlink.description: Step note, linked list: a node is removed.

noteSuccessor.default: Smallest key to the right of {key}: try {other}
noteSuccessor.description: Step note, search tree: looking for the successor of a key with two children.

noteTakesPlace.description: Step note, search tree: the successor replaces the removed key.

noteSplice.default: {key} has one child, which takes its place
noteSplice.description: Step note, search tree: removing a key with one child.

noteRemoveLeaf.default: {key} has no children: just remove it
noteRemoveLeaf.description: Step note, search tree: removing a leaf.
